title.narrative: Local-Led Climate Adaptation Initiative: Empowering Young People and Women through Solar Powered Water Supply and Sustainable Climate-Resilient Gardening in Muchila Chiefdom, Namwala, Southern Province, Zambia.

description.narrative: The project is being undertaken to address the issue of water access and promote women and youth empowerment in Muchila chiefdom, which has been severely affected by droughts as a result of climate change. The project intends to install solar-powered boreholes and promote climate-smart agriculture through community gardens to address water scarcity, food insecurity, and the impact of climate change. Additionally, it aims to empower women and youth through training and engagement, equipping them with skills for resilient farming practices, fostering economic independence and environmental stewardship. The project's innovative approach not only secures water resources but also cultivates climate-resilient leaders.
